authoring: Mechanism selection, Korean prose and overlap boundaries directly authored in conversation. Code only serializes authored rows and checks format.
catalog_review: Read group 18 catalog names and mechanisms; additionally searched cross-domain chemical, hydration, radical, transport, force and assembly keys. Broad generic enzyme-catalysis/ion-channel-modulation parents are retained; species/substrate-only duplicates were excluded.
retrieval_policy: stored_search_excerpt means the relevant text came through web search results, even when a long publisher body fragment was returned. reference_section means the publisher page section was opened and read. Direct open errors/CAPTCHA never upgrade scope.

rejected_candidates.reason: Shares cysteine-acyl thioester and subsequent amine attack with retained sortase transamidation; side-chain versus backbone substrate distinction alone was not enough.
Same E1/E2-related conjugation machinery and user specifically warned against gratuitous family splitting.
Cell outcome risks relabeling generic lipid peroxidation without a sufficiently isolated new mechanism.

rejected_candidates.candidate: pistol versus hammerhead versus hairpin ribozyme rows
rejected_candidates.reason: Kept small internal 2′OH transesterification as one mechanism despite varying acid/base residues; avoided species/class proliferation.
Potential substrate/protein implementation variant of existing geometric photoisomerization.
Temperature-dependent hairpin melting and accessibility largely reuses nucleic-acid-duplex-melting.
RNA-templated reverse transcription already exists; substrate and repeat-appending output insufficient alone.
Overlaps glutaredoxin thiol exchange plus existing intramolecular disulfide refolding/stabilization.
Proton abstraction/readdition stereocenter inversion closely parallels retained metal-assisted sugar epimerization unless a deeper cofactor mechanism is separately justified.
Reserved to root agent; not researched as additions here.

review_flags: methylation-protected-restriction-discrimination combines two already cataloged reactions through protective state-dependent recognition; functional mechanistic coupling is the justification.
voltage-sensor-gating-charge-displacement and bilayer-tension-mechanosensitive-channel-gating have broad ion-channel-modulation parent overlap; distinct work input and coupling are explicit.
hydrophobic-pore-dewetting-ion-gating has direct computational primary evidence and needs cautious interpretation; it is distinct from selectivity-filter coordination and from geometric closure.
complex-i-redox-coupled-proton-pumping retains only settled net coupling and explicitly marks molecular coupling mechanism disputed.

sortase-thioester-mediated-transpeptidation shares acyl-transfer chemistry with intein/NRPS but uses external enzyme cleavage of existing peptide and re-ligation; transglutaminase was omitted as a closer duplicate.
